plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says that Donald Menzel, an astronomer at Harvard in the 1950s, was caught destroying astronomical plates, the glass photographs of the night sky that observatories keep as records. Michels says the person who caught him was Dorrit Hoffleit, a respected Harvard astronomer whom he also describes as Menzel's assistant, and that she wrote about it in her book. If true, a leading scientist would have been getting rid of records of the sky.
